summary: React library for programmatically generating and rendering videos through code.
usecases: Generating personalized video content for marketing campaigns at scale
Automating video production for game highlights or sports recaps from data feeds
Building internal tools for creating dynamic UI walkthroughs or tutorial videos
ideas: Combine with AI text generation to auto-create video scripts and visuals
Integrate with real-time data streams to produce live-update videos (e.g., stock tickers, weather)
Use as a headless rendering engine for CI/CD-based video generation in deployment pipelines
